home.title: Meki Batu Union | Ethiopian Fruit & Vegetable Cooperative
home.description: Meki Batu Union empowers 135 primary cooperatives and 8,089 member farmers in the Ethiopian Rift Valley to deliver sustainable, export-quality produce worldwide.

about.title: About Us | Meki Batu Union
about.description: Learn about Meki Batu Union's history since 2002, our 135 member cooperatives, 8,089 farmers, GlobalG.A.P certification, and leadership dedicated to sustainable Ethiopian agriculture.

products.title: Our Products | Meki Batu Union
products.description: Explore our export-grade Ethiopian produce catalog including Rift Valley tomatoes, red onions, green peppers, highland potatoes, fresh papaya, and certified hybrid seeds.

farmers.title: For Farmers | Meki Batu Union
farmers.description: Discover union membership benefits, tractor services, certified seed distribution, and agronomic training for 8,089 farmers across 135 member cooperatives.

buyers.title: For Buyers & Exporters | Meki Batu Union
buyers.description: Source GlobalG.A.P certified Rift Valley vegetables, fruits, and hybrid seeds. Reliable cold chain, full traceability, and volume supply for domestic and international markets.

retailOutlets.title: Retail Outlets | Meki Batu Union
retailOutlets.description: Locate Meki Batu Union's five official retail storefronts across Addis Ababa supplying fresh, farm-direct produce to urban consumers.

news.title: News & Updates | Meki Batu Union
news.description: Read the latest updates on harvest forecasts, trade agreements, community initiatives, and infrastructure upgrades from Meki Batu Union.

impact.title: Our Impact | Meki Batu Union
impact.description: See how Meki Batu Union fosters sustainable farming, economic resilience, and community growth across 135 member cooperatives and 8,089 farmers in Ethiopia.

contact.title: Contact Us | Meki Batu Union
contact.description: Get in touch with Meki Batu Union headquarters in Meki, Oromia, Ethiopia. Reach out for export inquiries, cooperative membership, or sales.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy | Meki Batu Union
privacyPolicy.description: How Meki Batu Fruits and Vegetables Growers' Cooperative Union collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service | Meki Batu Union
termsOfService.description: The terms that apply when you use the Meki Batu Fruits and Vegetables Growers' Cooperative Union website.
